question: What should I do this week?
text:
ANSWER: Submit verification form now and plan for rent.
WHY:
- Refund held until form submitted [C4].
- Rent due soon leaves little cash [C9].
DO THIS:
1. Send verification form Tue, Oct 27 for $1,850 refund Thu, Nov 5 [C1][C3].
2. Pay rent $725 Sun, Nov 1 to avoid $35 fee [C6][C8].
NOTE: Send your verification form: your $1,850 refund [C2] then arrives around Thu, Nov 5 [C3]. Rent of $725 [C6] is due Sun, Nov 1 [C5] and leaves you just $13.32 [C7]. Last time, rent before payday cost a $35 fee [C8].
